name: Not  Lasagna
instructions: Spray an 8-inch glass baking dish with non-stick spray
Measure 1 / 2 cup spaghetti sauce from jar and spread evenly on bottom of dish
Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium heat
Add remaining spaghetti sauce , italian seasoning and garlic salt
Layer half of ravioli on the sauce in the dish
Spread half of the beef mixture over the ravioli and top with 1 cup of the mozzarella cheese
Repeat layers one more time , ending with cheese
Allow to stand for 5 minutes before serving
